# Environment setup + data cleaning

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(ggiraph)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)

source("./utils.R")
```

Here, we're removing the duplicates from our analysis.

```{r}
flock_df <- read.csv("../data/flock_combined_24-26.csv") %>% 
  filter(duplicate_likely == FALSE) %>% 
  select(-dup1_check,
         -dup2_check,
         -duplicate_likely)

nrow(flock_df)
```

```{r}
flock_df$Search.Time <- as.Date.character(flock_df$Search.Time, format="%Y-%m-%d")
```


# Filtering by Violent Crimes
List of violent crimes that we used to generate a list: https://jackdiamondlaw.com/violent-crimes/

```{r}
VIOLENT_CRIMES <- "murder|homicide|manslaughter|domestic assault|battery|dangerous weapon|kidnap|arson"

violent_df <- flock_df %>% 
  filter(grepl(VIOLENT_CRIMES, Reason, ignore.case = TRUE))
```

```{r}
percent_violent <- (nrow(violent_df) / nrow(flock_df)) * 100
print(paste("% of Flock searches that were for violent crime: ", percent_violent))
```

## What about in 2025?

```{r}
violent_25 <- violent_df %>% 
  filter(Search.Time >= as.Date("2025-01-01"),
         Search.Time <= as.Date("2025-12-31"))
```

```{r}
percent_violent <- (nrow(violent_25) / nrow(flock_df)) * 100
print(paste("% of Flock searches that were for violent crime in 2025: ", percent_violent))
```
